Definition: properly, to dangle, i.e. to let down a bucket (for drawing out water); figuratively, to deliver
BiblicalUsage: 1) to draw, dangle; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to draw; 1a2) drawing advice (fig.); 1b) (Piel) to draw up
